topics.name: Cervical Degenerative Disease
topics.blurb: Cervical radiculopathy, degenerative cervical myelopathy, and anterior/posterior decompression options.

topics.name: Lumbar Degenerative Disease
topics.blurb: Disc herniation, stenosis, spondylolisthesis, and the fusion-versus-decompression controversy.

topics.name: Thoracic Degenerative Disease
topics.blurb: Thoracic disc herniation, myelopathy, and approach selection for a unforgiving cord.

topics.name: Spinal Deformity
topics.blurb: Coronal/sagittal balance, idiopathic and adult deformity, osteotomies, and junctional failure.

topics.name: Spine Trauma
topics.blurb: Cervical and thoracolumbar fracture classification, craniovertebral injuries, and surgical indications.

topics.name: Spinal Cord Injury
topics.blurb: ASIA grading, cord syndromes, shock states, hemodynamics, and timing of decompression.

topics.name: Spinal Oncology
topics.blurb: Metastatic cord compression, NOMS/SINS frameworks, separation surgery, and primary bony tumors.

topics.name: Spinal Infection
topics.blurb: Osteomyelitis/discitis, epidural abscess, tuberculous spondylitis, and postoperative infection.

topics.name: Instrumentation and Fusion Techniques
topics.blurb: Screw anatomy and trajectories, interbody options, fixation constructs, biologics, and pseudarthrosis.

topics.name: Spine Surgery Complications
topics.blurb: Durotomy, CSF leak, postoperative hematoma, approach-related and positioning injuries.

topics.name: Intradural Extramedullary Lesions
topics.blurb: Schwannoma, meningioma, arachnoid cyst, syringomyelia, and adult tethered cord.

concepts.name: Cervical spondylosis
concepts.blurb: Age-related disc desiccation, osteophytes, and ligament hypertrophy narrowing canal and foramina.
acgme: Cervical Disc Disease - ACDF (1-4 Levels)

concepts.name: Cervical radiculopathy
concepts.blurb: Dermatomal arm pain/weakness from foraminal nerve-root compression; C6 and C7 most common.
acgme: Spine Neurological Examination - Localizing Radiculopathy and Myelopathy

concepts.name: Radiculopathy versus myelopathy
concepts.blurb: Root compression gives dermatomal LMN signs; cord compression gives UMN signs, gait, and dexterity loss.
acgme: Spine Neurological Examination - Localizing Radiculopathy and Myelopathy

concepts.name: Degenerative cervical myelopathy natural history
concepts.blurb: Stepwise or progressive cord dysfunction; surgery halts decline, rarely reverses established deficits.
acgme: Cervical Myelopathy - Pathophysiology Grading and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: Myelopathy examination signs
concepts.blurb: Hoffmann, hyperreflexia, clonus, Babinski, gait ataxia, and loss of hand dexterity localize cord compression.
acgme: Spine Neurological Examination - Localizing Radiculopathy and Myelopathy

concepts.name: Modified Japanese Orthopaedic Association score
concepts.blurb: 18-point myelopathy severity scale; mild 15-17, moderate 12-14, severe under 12, guides surgery.
acgme: Cervical Myelopathy - Pathophysiology Grading and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: Anterior cervical discectomy and fusion
concepts.blurb: Smith-Robinson approach to decompress disc/osteophyte and fuse; workhorse for anterior cervical pathology.
acgme: Cervical Disc Disease - ACDF (1-4 Levels)

concepts.name: ACDF complications
concepts.blurb: Dysphagia, recurrent laryngeal nerve palsy, pseudarthrosis, adjacent-segment disease, and esophageal injury.
acgme: Cervical Disc Disease - ACDF (1-4 Levels)

concepts.name: Cervical corpectomy
concepts.blurb: Vertebral body removal for retrovertebral compression or OPLL; strut graft spans the defect.
acgme: Corpectomy and Multi-Level ACDF (3-4 Levels)

concepts.name: Cervical disc arthroplasty
concepts.blurb: Motion-preserving disc replacement; IDE trials show noninferiority and possibly less adjacent-segment reoperation.
acgme: Cervical Disc Disease - ACDF (1-4 Levels)

concepts.name: Posterior cervical foraminotomy
concepts.blurb: Keyhole laminoforaminotomy for lateral soft disc/foraminal radiculopathy; motion-preserving, no fusion.
acgme: Posterior Cervical Foraminotomy for Radiculopathy

concepts.name: Cervical laminoplasty
concepts.blurb: Posterior expansile canal enlargement preserving motion; needs lordosis and competent posterior tension band.
acgme: Posterior Cervical Laminectomy with Lateral Mass Fixation

concepts.name: Cervical laminectomy and fusion
concepts.blurb: Posterior decompression with lateral mass instrumentation; preferred when kyphosis or instability precludes laminoplasty.
acgme: Posterior Cervical Laminectomy with Lateral Mass Fixation

concepts.name: Ossification of the posterior longitudinal ligament
concepts.blurb: Heterotopic ossification compressing the cord; high dural-tear risk, K-line guides anterior versus posterior surgery.
acgme: Cervical Myelopathy - Pathophysiology Grading and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: C5 palsy
concepts.blurb: Postdecompression deltoid/biceps weakness from root tethering; usually delayed and largely self-limited.
acgme: Cervical Myelopathy - Pathophysiology Grading and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: Lumbar disc herniation
concepts.blurb: Nucleus pulposus herniation compressing the traversing root; paramedian most common, L4-5 and L5-S1 dominate.
acgme: Lumbar Disc Herniation - Pathophysiology and Microdiscectomy

concepts.name: Disc herniation natural history
concepts.blurb: Most radiculopathy resolves with conservative care; herniations resorb, so surgery is largely elective.
acgme: Lumbar Disc Herniation - Pathophysiology and Microdiscectomy

concepts.name: Lumbar radiculopathy
concepts.blurb: Dermatomal leg pain with positive straight-leg raise; traversing root affected by paramedian disc.
acgme: Spine Neurological Examination - Localizing Radiculopathy and Myelopathy

concepts.name: Lumbar microdiscectomy
concepts.blurb: Microsurgical fragment removal for radiculopathy refractory to conservative care or with progressive deficit.
acgme: Lumbar Disc Herniation - Pathophysiology and Microdiscectomy

concepts.name: SPORT trial
concepts.blurb: Surgery for disc herniation, stenosis, and spondylolisthesis gave faster relief; crossover blurred intent-to-treat.
acgme: Lumbar Disc Herniation - Pathophysiology and Microdiscectomy

concepts.name: Cauda equina syndrome
concepts.blurb: Surgical emergency: urinary retention, saddle anesthesia, bilateral sciatica; decompress urgently to preserve function.
acgme: Lumbar Disc Herniation - Pathophysiology and Microdiscectomy

concepts.name: Lumbar spinal stenosis
concepts.blurb: Central/lateral recess/foraminal narrowing from facet and ligamentum hypertrophy causing neurogenic claudication.
acgme: Lumbar Spinal Stenosis - Laminectomy and Decompression

concepts.name: Neurogenic claudication
concepts.blurb: Positional leg symptoms relieved by flexion (shopping-cart sign); worse standing/walking, better sitting.
acgme: Lumbar Spinal Stenosis - Laminectomy and Decompression

concepts.name: Neurogenic versus vascular claudication
concepts.blurb: Neurogenic relieved by flexion with preserved pulses; vascular relieved by standing still with diminished pulses.
acgme: Lumbar Spinal Stenosis - Laminectomy and Decompression

concepts.name: Lumbar laminectomy and decompression
concepts.blurb: Posterior decompression for stenosis; preserve pars and facets to avoid iatrogenic instability.
acgme: Lumbar Spinal Stenosis - Laminectomy and Decompression

concepts.name: Spondylolisthesis classification
concepts.blurb: Wiltse etiologic types (dysplastic, isthmic, degenerative, traumatic, pathologic); Meyerding grades slip percentage.
acgme: Lumbar Spondylolisthesis - Meyerding Classification and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Degenerative spondylolisthesis
concepts.blurb: Slip with intact pars from facet arthropathy, classically L4-5; stenosis often dominates presentation.
acgme: Lumbar Spondylolisthesis - Meyerding Classification and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Isthmic spondylolisthesis
concepts.blurb: Slip from pars interarticularis defect (spondylolysis), classically L5-S1 in younger patients.
acgme: Lumbar Spondylolisthesis - Meyerding Classification and Surgical Management

concepts.name: SLIP trial
concepts.blurb: Decompression plus fusion bettered decompression alone in degenerative spondylolisthesis; SPORT-component countered by Swedish trial.
aliases: spinal laminectomy versus instrumented pedicle screw
acgme: Lumbar Spondylolisthesis - Meyerding Classification and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Lumbar fusion indications controversy
concepts.blurb: Fusion clearest for instability, deformity, and listhesis; benefit over decompression alone debated in stenosis.
acgme: Single-Level Instrumented Lumbar Fusion (TLIF or PLIF or ALIF)

concepts.name: Adjacent segment disease
concepts.blurb: Accelerated degeneration above/below a fusion from altered biomechanics; distinguish symptomatic disease from radiographic change.
acgme: Adjacent Segment Disease After Spinal Fusion

concepts.name: Far lateral disc herniation
concepts.blurb: Foraminal/extraforaminal disc compresses the exiting root (one level higher); favors paramedian/Wiltse approach.
acgme: Lumbar Disc Herniation - Pathophysiology and Microdiscectomy

concepts.name: Recurrent disc herniation
concepts.blurb: Re-herniation at the operated level after a pain-free interval; revision discectomy versus fusion is judgment.
acgme: Lumbar Disc Herniation - Pathophysiology and Microdiscectomy

concepts.name: Thoracic disc herniation
concepts.blurb: Often calcified and central; many incidental, but symptomatic cases threaten a watershed cord region.
acgme: Spine MRI and CT Interpretation - Disc Stenosis Fracture Tumor

concepts.name: Thoracic myelopathy
concepts.blurb: Lower-extremity UMN signs, gait disturbance, and a sensory level from thoracic cord compression.
acgme: Spine Neurological Examination - Localizing Radiculopathy and Myelopathy

concepts.name: Calcified thoracic disc and intradural extension
concepts.blurb: CT defines calcification; intradural extension raises dural-defect risk and steers approach selection.
acgme: Spine MRI and CT Interpretation - Disc Stenosis Fracture Tumor

concepts.name: Thoracic disc surgical approaches
concepts.blurb: Avoid posterior laminectomy alone; transthoracic, transpedicular, costotransversectomy, or lateral extracavitary reach central discs safely.
acgme: Spine MRI and CT Interpretation - Disc Stenosis Fracture Tumor

concepts.name: Ossification of the ligamentum flavum
concepts.blurb: Posterior thoracic cord compression from ossified ligamentum flavum; treated by posterior decompression.
acgme: Spine MRI and CT Interpretation - Disc Stenosis Fracture Tumor

concepts.name: Spinopelvic parameters
concepts.blurb: Pelvic incidence (fixed) = pelvic tilt + sacral slope; PI sets the ideal lumbar lordosis.
acgme: Adult Spinal Deformity - Scoliosis and Sagittal Balance

concepts.name: PI-LL mismatch
concepts.blurb: Lumbar lordosis should approximate pelvic incidence; mismatch over 10 degrees predicts disability and PJK.
acgme: Adult Spinal Deformity - Scoliosis and Sagittal Balance

concepts.name: Sagittal vertical axis
concepts.blurb: C7 plumb line offset from posterosuperior S1; over 5 cm signals positive sagittal imbalance.
acgme: Adult Spinal Deformity - Scoliosis and Sagittal Balance

concepts.name: Coronal balance
concepts.blurb: C7 plumb line offset from central sacral vertical line in the coronal plane.
acgme: Adult Spinal Deformity - Scoliosis and Sagittal Balance

concepts.name: Cobb angle
concepts.blurb: Coronal curve magnitude between most-tilted end vertebrae; thresholds drive bracing and surgery.
acgme: Plain Radiography of the Spine - Trauma Deformity Hardware Assessment

concepts.name: Adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
concepts.blurb: Structural coronal curve in growing adolescents; observe, brace at ~25 degrees, surgery near 45-50 degrees.
acgme: Adult Spinal Deformity - Scoliosis and Sagittal Balance

concepts.name: Lenke classification
concepts.blurb: AIS curve type, lumbar modifier, and sagittal modifier that guide selection of fusion levels.
acgme: Adult Spinal Deformity - Scoliosis and Sagittal Balance

concepts.name: Adult spinal deformity
concepts.blurb: Degenerative/de novo scoliosis and sagittal malalignment; disability driven by sagittal imbalance more than curve size.
acgme: Adult Spinal Deformity - Scoliosis and Sagittal Balance

concepts.name: SRS-Schwab classification
concepts.blurb: Adult deformity classification by curve type plus PI-LL, SVA, and PT sagittal modifiers.
acgme: Adult Spinal Deformity - Scoliosis and Sagittal Balance

concepts.name: Smith-Petersen / Ponte osteotomy
concepts.blurb: Posterior column osteotomy hinging on the disc; ~10 degrees correction per level over mobile segments.
acgme: Ponte Osteotomy for Deformity Correction

concepts.name: Pedicle subtraction osteotomy
concepts.blurb: Three-column wedge resection through one vertebra for ~30 degrees of fixed sagittal correction.
acgme: Pedicle Subtraction and Vertebral Column Resection Osteotomy

concepts.name: Vertebral column resection
concepts.blurb: Complete vertebral body and posterior element removal for rigid, angular, multiplanar deformity; highest neurologic risk.
acgme: Pedicle Subtraction and Vertebral Column Resection Osteotomy

concepts.name: Proximal junctional kyphosis
concepts.blurb: Kyphotic breakdown above a long fusion; PJF adds fracture, hardware failure, or neurologic decline.
acgme: Adult Spinal Deformity - Scoliosis and Sagittal Balance

concepts.name: Flatback syndrome
concepts.blurb: Loss of lumbar lordosis (often iatrogenic) causing forward stoop and effortful upright posture.
acgme: Adult Spinal Deformity - Scoliosis and Sagittal Balance

concepts.name: Cervical sagittal deformity
concepts.blurb: Cervical kyphosis and chin-brow imbalance assessed by cSVA and T1 slope; affects horizontal gaze.
acgme: Adult Spinal Deformity - Scoliosis and Sagittal Balance

concepts.name: Cervical spine clearance
concepts.blurb: NEXUS and Canadian C-spine rules select imaging; CT clears bony injury, MRI/exam clears ligaments.
acgme: Cervical Spine Fractures - Classification and Surgical or Non-Surgical Management

concepts.name: Thoracolumbar Injury Classification and Severity score
concepts.blurb: Morphology, posterior ligamentous complex, and neurology; total over 4 favors surgery, under 4 nonoperative.
acgme: Thoracolumbar Fractures - AO Classification and Surgical Indications

concepts.name: Subaxial Cervical Injury Classification
concepts.blurb: Morphology, discoligamentous complex, and neurology for C3-C7; total over 4 favors surgery.
acgme: Cervical Spine Fractures - Classification and Surgical or Non-Surgical Management

concepts.name: AO Spine classification
concepts.blurb: Morphology types A (compression), B (tension band), C (translation) with neurologic and modifier qualifiers.
acgme: Thoracolumbar Fractures - AO Classification and Surgical Indications

concepts.name: Atlas (C1) fractures
concepts.blurb: C1 ring fractures; transverse ligament integrity (rule of Spence, ADI) decides stability and management.
acgme: Occipitocervical Junction Surgery (C0-C2 Fixation Odontoid Fractures)

concepts.name: Jefferson fracture
concepts.blurb: Burst fracture of the C1 ring from axial load; instability hinges on transverse ligament competence.
acgme: Occipitocervical Junction Surgery (C0-C2 Fixation Odontoid Fractures)

concepts.name: Odontoid fractures
concepts.blurb: Anderson-D'Alonzo types I (tip), II (base, nonunion-prone), III (body); type II dominates decision-making.
acgme: Occipitocervical Junction Surgery (C0-C2 Fixation Odontoid Fractures)

concepts.name: Odontoid fracture management
concepts.blurb: Type II options: anterior odontoid screw versus posterior C1-C2 fusion versus halo; age and displacement decide.
acgme: Occipitocervical Junction Surgery (C0-C2 Fixation Odontoid Fractures)

concepts.name: Hangman's fracture
concepts.blurb: Traumatic C2 spondylolisthesis through pars; Levine-Edwards grades guide traction versus surgery.
acgme: Occipitocervical Junction Surgery (C0-C2 Fixation Odontoid Fractures)

concepts.name: Atlanto-occipital dissociation
concepts.blurb: Highly unstable craniocervical ligamentous disruption; avoid traction, stabilize with occipitocervical fusion.
acgme: Occipitocervical Junction Surgery (C0-C2 Fixation Odontoid Fractures)

concepts.name: Atlantoaxial instability
concepts.blurb: Excess C1-C2 motion from transverse ligament/dens incompetence; ADI thresholds (>3 mm adult, >5 mm child).
acgme: Occipitocervical Junction Surgery (C0-C2 Fixation Odontoid Fractures)

concepts.name: Subaxial cervical facet injuries
concepts.blurb: Unilateral/bilateral facet dislocations from flexion-distraction; reduction and fixation restore alignment and decompress.
acgme: Cervical Spine Fractures - Classification and Surgical or Non-Surgical Management

concepts.name: Closed reduction with cervical traction
concepts.blurb: Gardner-Wells tongs and serial weights reduce facet dislocations; awake exams monitor for neurologic worsening.
acgme: Cervical Traction - Gardner-Wells Tong Application and Fluoroscopic Reduction

concepts.name: Thoracolumbar burst fracture management
concepts.blurb: Axial-load comminution with retropulsion; intact PLC and neurology often allow bracing, deficits favor decompression/stabilization.
acgme: Thoracolumbar Fractures - AO Classification and Surgical Indications

concepts.name: Flexion-distraction (Chance) injury
concepts.blurb: Tension-band failure across all three columns (seatbelt mechanism); unstable, associated with hollow-viscus injury.
acgme: Thoracolumbar Fractures - AO Classification and Surgical Indications

concepts.name: Ankylosed spine fractures
concepts.blurb: DISH/ankylosing spondylitis create brittle long-lever fractures from minor trauma; highly unstable, long-segment fixation needed.
acgme: Thoracolumbar Fractures - AO Classification and Surgical Indications

concepts.name: Blunt vertebral artery injury screening
concepts.blurb: Denver criteria (foramen transversarium, facet, or high cervical fractures) prompt CTA; treat to prevent stroke.
acgme: Traumatic Carotid and Vertebral Artery Dissection - Screening and Management

concepts.name: Sacral fractures
concepts.blurb: Denis zones and Roy-Camille transverse patterns; zone III/U-type risk cauda equina and spinopelvic instability.
acgme: Thoracolumbar Fractures - AO Classification and Surgical Indications

concepts.name: ASIA / ISNCSCI examination
concepts.blurb: Standardized motor (10 myotomes) and sensory (28 dermatomes) exam defining neurologic level and completeness.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: ASIA Impairment Scale
concepts.blurb: Grades A (complete) through E (normal) by motor/sensory preservation below the neurologic level.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Sacral sparing
concepts.blurb: Preserved S4-S5 sensation, voluntary anal contraction, or deep anal pressure defines an incomplete injury.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Bulbocavernosus reflex
concepts.blurb: Sacral reflex arc; its return marks the end of spinal shock, allowing true injury grading.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Complete versus incomplete injury
concepts.blurb: Completeness depends on sacral sparing, not symmetry; incomplete injuries carry better recovery prognosis.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Central cord syndrome
concepts.blurb: Hyperextension in spondylotic neck; arms weaker than legs with variable sensory and bladder involvement.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Anterior cord syndrome
concepts.blurb: Anterior spinal artery territory loss: motor and spinothalamic deficit with preserved dorsal column function; poor prognosis.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Brown-Séquard syndrome
concepts.blurb: Cord hemisection: ipsilateral motor and dorsal column loss, contralateral pain/temperature loss; best prognosis.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Posterior cord syndrome
concepts.blurb: Dorsal column loss with proprioceptive/vibratory deficit and sensory ataxia; motor and pain largely preserved.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Conus medullaris syndrome
concepts.blurb: Injury at the cord terminus: early symmetric bladder/bowel dysfunction, saddle anesthesia, mixed UMN/LMN signs.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Conus versus cauda equina
concepts.blurb: Conus: early symmetric sphincter loss, UMN signs; cauda: asymmetric radicular pain, areflexia, late bladder loss.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Neurogenic shock
concepts.blurb: Loss of sympathetic tone above T6 causing hypotension with bradycardia; a hemodynamic, distributive shock state.
acgme: Neurogenic Shock - Spinal Cord Injury - MAP Goals Vasopressors Fluids

concepts.name: Spinal shock
concepts.blurb: Transient areflexia and flaccidity below the injury; resolution heralded by returning bulbocavernosus reflex.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Neurogenic versus spinal shock
concepts.blurb: Neurogenic is a cardiovascular state (hypotension, bradycardia); spinal shock is a neurologic state (areflexia).
acgme: Neurogenic Shock - Spinal Cord Injury - MAP Goals Vasopressors Fluids

concepts.name: MAP augmentation after SCI
concepts.blurb: Maintain MAP 85-90 mmHg for ~7 days to support cord perfusion; vasopressors and euvolemia.
acgme: Neurogenic Shock - Spinal Cord Injury - MAP Goals Vasopressors Fluids

concepts.name: Methylprednisolone in SCI (NASCIS)
concepts.blurb: NASCIS trials suggested modest benefit on secondary analyses; routine high-dose steroids no longer recommended.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Timing of decompression (STASCIS)
concepts.blurb: Early decompression (<24 h) associated with improved neurologic recovery after acute cord injury.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Autonomic dysreflexia
concepts.blurb: Chronic injury above T6: noxious stimulus triggers paroxysmal hypertension and bradycardia; remove trigger, treat BP.
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: SCIWORA
concepts.blurb: Spinal cord injury without radiographic abnormality; ligamentous laxity in children, MRI reveals cord signal.
aliases: spinal cord injury without radiographic abnormality
acgme: Acute Spinal Cord Injury - Classification (ASIA) Medical and Surgical Management

concepts.name: Spinal metastasis epidemiology
concepts.blurb: Spine is the commonest osseous metastatic site; breast, lung, prostate predominate, mostly thoracic and osteolytic.
acgme: Spinal Metastatic Disease - SINS Score and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: Metastatic epidural spinal cord compression
concepts.blurb: Oncologic emergency: progressive myelopathy from epidural tumor; start steroids and urgently image whole spine.
acgme: Spinal Metastatic Disease - SINS Score and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: Epidural spinal cord compression grading
concepts.blurb: Bilsky 6-point scale of epidural tumor and cord effacement; grades 2-3 favor surgical decompression.
acgme: Spinal Metastatic Disease - SINS Score and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: Patchell trial
concepts.blurb: Decompressive surgery plus radiotherapy beat radiotherapy alone for ambulation in metastatic cord compression.
acgme: Spinal Metastatic Disease - SINS Score and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: Spinal Instability Neoplastic Score
concepts.blurb: Six elements grade neoplastic instability; 7-12 indeterminate, 13-18 unstable and prompts surgical consultation.
acgme: Spinal Metastatic Disease - SINS Score and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: NOMS decision framework
concepts.blurb: Integrates Neurologic, Oncologic, Mechanical, and Systemic factors to choose radiation, surgery, or both.
acgme: Spinal Metastatic Disease - SINS Score and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: Separation surgery
concepts.blurb: Circumferential epidural decompression creating a tumor-cord margin for safe postoperative stereotactic radiosurgery.
acgme: Spinal Metastatic Disease - SINS Score and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: Spine stereotactic body radiotherapy
concepts.blurb: High-dose conformal radiation effective even for radioresistant histologies; enables durable local tumor control.
acgme: Spinal Metastatic Disease - SINS Score and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: Vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty
concepts.blurb: Percutaneous cement augmentation for painful osteoporotic or neoplastic compression fractures without epidural compression.
acgme: Vertebroplasty and Kyphoplasty for Osteoporotic Fractures

concepts.name: Vertebral hemangioma
concepts.blurb: Common benign vascular lesion with corduroy/polka-dot vertebra; rarely aggressive enough to compress the cord.
acgme: Spine MRI and CT Interpretation - Disc Stenosis Fracture Tumor

concepts.name: Spinal chordoma
concepts.blurb: Notochord-derived malignant tumor of sacrum/clivus; en bloc resection with wide margins is key oncologic goal.
acgme: Spinal Metastatic Disease - SINS Score and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: Osteoid osteoma
concepts.blurb: Benign posterior-element nidus (<2 cm) causing night pain relieved by NSAIDs; painful scoliosis in adolescents.
acgme: Spine MRI and CT Interpretation - Disc Stenosis Fracture Tumor

concepts.name: Osteoblastoma
concepts.blurb: Benign bone-forming posterior-element tumor (>2 cm); more aggressive and expansile than osteoid osteoma.
acgme: Spine MRI and CT Interpretation - Disc Stenosis Fracture Tumor

concepts.name: Aneurysmal bone cyst
concepts.blurb: Expansile blood-filled lesion with fluid-fluid levels on MRI; posterior elements of young patients.
acgme: Spine MRI and CT Interpretation - Disc Stenosis Fracture Tumor

concepts.name: Giant cell tumor of the spine
concepts.blurb: Locally aggressive lytic vertebral-body tumor (sacrum common); denosumab and en bloc resection considered.
acgme: Spine MRI and CT Interpretation - Disc Stenosis Fracture Tumor

concepts.name: Multiple myeloma and plasmacytoma
concepts.blurb: Plasma-cell malignancy causing lytic vertebral lesions and pathologic fractures; radiosensitive, often managed nonoperatively.
acgme: Spinal Metastatic Disease - SINS Score and Surgical Decision-Making

concepts.name: Vertebral osteomyelitis and discitis
concepts.blurb: Hematogenous endplate/disc infection (often S. aureus); insidious back pain, raised inflammatory markers.
acgme: Spinal Epidural Abscess - Diagnosis Emergent Decompression Antibiotics

concepts.name: Spinal infection workup
concepts.blurb: ESR/CRP, blood cultures, and contrast MRI; CT-guided biopsy targets organism before tailored antibiotics.
acgme: Spinal Epidural Abscess - Diagnosis Emergent Decompression Antibiotics

concepts.name: Spinal epidural abscess
concepts.blurb: Classic triad of fever, back pain, and neurologic deficit; surgical emergency when cord/cauda compressed.
acgme: Spinal Epidural Abscess - Diagnosis Emergent Decompression Antibiotics

concepts.name: Epidural abscess management
concepts.blurb: Urgent decompression/drainage for deficit or progression; selected neurologically intact cases trialed on antibiotics with monitoring.
acgme: Spinal Epidural Abscess - Diagnosis Emergent Decompression Antibiotics

concepts.name: Tuberculous spondylitis (Pott disease)
concepts.blurb: Indolent TB infection sparing the disc with anterior collapse, gibbus deformity, and paraspinal cold abscess.
acgme: Spinal Epidural Abscess - Diagnosis Emergent Decompression Antibiotics

concepts.name: Postoperative spinal wound infection
concepts.blurb: Surgical-site infection presenting with drainage and pain; irrigation/debridement with hardware retention when possible.
acgme: Surgical Site Infection in Neurosurgery - Prevention Diagnosis and Treatment

concepts.name: Pedicle screw anatomy and trajectory
concepts.blurb: Pedicle width, angle, and length vary by level; medial breach risks the cord/root, lateral risks vessels.
acgme: Pedicle Screw Placement - Technique Trajectory and Complication Avoidance

concepts.name: Freehand pedicle screw technique
concepts.blurb: Anatomic starting points, gearshift probe, ball-tipped feeler for breach, and stimulation confirm safe placement.
acgme: Pedicle Screw Placement - Technique Trajectory and Complication Avoidance

concepts.name: Cervical pedicle screws
concepts.blurb: Highest pullout strength in the subaxial spine but narrow margins near vertebral artery and root.
acgme: Pedicle Screw Placement - Technique Trajectory and Complication Avoidance

concepts.name: Lateral mass screws
concepts.blurb: Workhorse subaxial cervical fixation (C3-C6); Magerl/Roy-Camille trajectories avoid the root and vertebral artery.
acgme: Posterior Cervical Laminectomy with Lateral Mass Fixation

concepts.name: C1-C2 fixation options
concepts.blurb: Goel-Harms C1 lateral mass with C2 pedicle screws is the modern workhorse for atlantoaxial fusion.
acgme: Occipitocervical Junction Surgery (C0-C2 Fixation Odontoid Fractures)

concepts.name: Transarticular C1-C2 screws
concepts.blurb: Magerl screws cross the C1-C2 joint; biomechanically strong but high vertebral artery injury risk.
acgme: Occipitocervical Junction Surgery (C0-C2 Fixation Odontoid Fractures)

concepts.name: C2 fixation options
concepts.blurb: C2 pedicle, pars, and translaminar screws differ in vertebral artery risk and pullout strength.
acgme: Occipitocervical Junction Surgery (C0-C2 Fixation Odontoid Fractures)

concepts.name: Occipitocervical fusion
concepts.blurb: Occipital plate to cervical screws for craniocervical instability; fix occipitocervical angle to preserve gaze/swallow.
acgme: Occipitocervical Junction Surgery (C0-C2 Fixation Odontoid Fractures)

concepts.name: Transforaminal lumbar interbody fusion
concepts.blurb: Unilateral facetectomy and posterolateral interbody placement; less retraction than PLIF, single-approach access.
acgme: Single-Level Instrumented Lumbar Fusion (TLIF or PLIF or ALIF)

concepts.name: Posterior lumbar interbody fusion
concepts.blurb: Bilateral posterior interbody placement requiring thecal/root retraction; higher dural and neural risk.
acgme: Single-Level Instrumented Lumbar Fusion (TLIF or PLIF or ALIF)

concepts.name: Anterior lumbar interbody fusion
concepts.blurb: Retroperitoneal anterior approach with large lordotic cage; risks great vessels and retrograde ejaculation.
acgme: Single-Level Instrumented Lumbar Fusion (TLIF or PLIF or ALIF)

concepts.name: Lateral lumbar interbody fusion
concepts.blurb: Transpsoas/lateral access for wide cage and indirect decompression; risks lumbar plexus and thigh symptoms.
acgme: Minimally Invasive Lumbar Surgery - MIS Discectomy and Fusion

concepts.name: Interbody fusion principles
concepts.blurb: Restores disc height, lordosis, and indirect foraminal decompression; cage on apophyseal ring resists subsidence.
acgme: Single-Level Instrumented Lumbar Fusion (TLIF or PLIF or ALIF)

concepts.name: Iliac and pelvic fixation
concepts.blurb: Iliac or S2-alar-iliac screws anchor long constructs across the lumbosacral junction to reduce caudal failure.
acgme: Pedicle Screw Placement - Technique Trajectory and Complication Avoidance

concepts.name: Navigation and robotic screw placement
concepts.blurb: Image guidance and robotics improve screw accuracy and reduce radiation; registration errors remain a pitfall.
acgme: Pedicle Screw Placement - Technique Trajectory and Complication Avoidance

concepts.name: Minimally invasive spine principles
concepts.blurb: Tubular retractors and percutaneous screws spare muscle; trade-offs include learning curve and radiation exposure.
acgme: Minimally Invasive Lumbar Surgery - MIS Discectomy and Fusion

concepts.name: Bone graft options
concepts.blurb: Autograft is osteogenic/inductive/conductive gold standard; allograft, ceramics, and DBM substitute with trade-offs.
acgme: Single-Level Instrumented Lumbar Fusion (TLIF or PLIF or ALIF)

concepts.name: Recombinant BMP-2
concepts.blurb: Potent osteoinductive protein (on-label ALIF); off-label cervical use risks dangerous airway swelling.
acgme: Single-Level Instrumented Lumbar Fusion (TLIF or PLIF or ALIF)

concepts.name: Spinal hardware failure
concepts.blurb: Rod fracture, screw pullout, or loosening, often signaling underlying pseudarthrosis or excessive mechanical load.
acgme: Single-Level Instrumented Lumbar Fusion (TLIF or PLIF or ALIF)

concepts.name: Pseudarthrosis
concepts.blurb: Failure of bony fusion causing recurrent pain and hardware loosening; smoking and NSAIDs are key risk factors.
acgme: Single-Level Instrumented Lumbar Fusion (TLIF or PLIF or ALIF)

concepts.name: Incidental durotomy
concepts.blurb: Intraoperative dural tear; primary watertight repair, augmented closure, and flat bed rest limit CSF leak.
acgme: Intraoperative Durotomy and CSF Leak - Repair and Management

concepts.name: CSF leak management
concepts.blurb: Persistent leak/pseudomeningocele managed by bed rest, lumbar drainage, or reoperation for revision repair.
acgme: Intraoperative Durotomy and CSF Leak - Repair and Management

concepts.name: Postoperative spinal epidural hematoma
concepts.blurb: New or worsening deficit with severe pain hours after surgery; emergent MRI and evacuation preserve function.
acgme: Intraoperative Durotomy and CSF Leak - Repair and Management

concepts.name: Positioning-related injuries
concepts.blurb: Prone positioning risks postoperative vision loss, peripheral nerve palsy, and pressure injury; pad and check pressure points.
acgme: Pedicle Screw Placement - Technique Trajectory and Complication Avoidance

concepts.name: Intraoperative vertebral artery injury
concepts.blurb: Drilling or screw placement near the V2/V3 segment; tamponade, repair, then angiography to assess infarct risk.
acgme: Traumatic Carotid and Vertebral Artery Dissection - Screening and Management

concepts.name: Dysphagia after anterior cervical surgery
concepts.blurb: Common transient swallowing difficulty from retraction and prevertebral edema; persistent cases need swallow evaluation.
acgme: Cervical Disc Disease - ACDF (1-4 Levels)

concepts.name: Recurrent laryngeal nerve injury
concepts.blurb: Hoarseness/vocal cord palsy after anterior cervical retraction; left-sided approach has a more predictable nerve course.
acgme: Cervical Disc Disease - ACDF (1-4 Levels)

concepts.name: Instrumentation failure
concepts.blurb: Screw loosening, rod fracture, or cage migration, often signaling pseudarthrosis or junctional overload.
acgme: Adjacent Segment Disease After Spinal Fusion

concepts.name: Intradural extramedullary differential
concepts.blurb: Schwannoma and meningioma dominate the IDEM compartment; MRI shows cord displacement with a CSF cleft.
acgme: Intradural Extramedullary Tumors (Meningioma Schwannoma) Resection

concepts.name: Spinal schwannoma
concepts.blurb: Encapsulated nerve-sheath tumor, often dumbbell-shaped through the foramen; gross-total resection is usually curative.
acgme: Intradural Extramedullary Tumors (Meningioma Schwannoma) Resection

concepts.name: Spinal neurofibroma
concepts.blurb: Nerve-sheath tumor enveloping fascicles (NF1-associated); resection often sacrifices the parent nerve.
acgme: Intradural Extramedullary Tumors (Meningioma Schwannoma) Resection

concepts.name: Spinal meningioma
concepts.blurb: Dural-based, often calcified thoracic tumor in middle-aged women; Simpson-grade resection minimizes recurrence.
acgme: Intradural Extramedullary Tumors (Meningioma Schwannoma) Resection

concepts.name: Spinal arachnoid cyst
concepts.blurb: CSF-signal intradural cyst causing cord compression or syrinx; fenestration relieves a CSF-flow block.
acgme: Intradural Extramedullary Tumors (Meningioma Schwannoma) Resection

concepts.name: Syringomyelia
concepts.blurb: Fluid-filled cord cavity causing cape-like dissociated sensory loss; treat the underlying CSF-flow cause.
acgme: Spine MRI and CT Interpretation - Disc Stenosis Fracture Tumor

concepts.name: Adult tethered cord syndrome
concepts.blurb: Low-lying conus and thickened filum cause progressive back/leg pain and bladder dysfunction; sectioning the filum detethers.
acgme: Tethered Spinal Cord - Filum Terminale Section Lipomyelomeningocele
